description: The Colt Model 1861 Navy cap & ball .36-caliber revolver was a six-shot, single-action percussion weapon produced by Colt's Manufacturing Company from 1861 until 1873.

The Colt Ring Lever Rifle was one of the first true lever-action rifles, designed to utilize the same caplock ammo as Colt revolvers, in this case the same .44 caliber as the Colt M1861 Navy.  It was famously used in the second Seminole war, where the Seminole people had learned to strike American soldiers while they were reloading their muskets.
